title: Calculations predict a novel desired compound containing eight catenated nitrogen atoms: 1-amino-tetrazolo-[4,5-b]tetrazole
abstract: A novel 8-N conjoined energetic compound 1-amino-tetrazolo-[4,5-                     b                     ]tetrazole has been designed and investigated at the DFT-B3LYP/6-311++G** level of theory.
